title: Report Re Edward Marvin, Alias Ma Wing, Alias Ng Yick Wing

CONFIDENTIAL
MEMO. NO. 397.

（批：File copy）

（印：C. & S. D. REGISTRY
S. D. D. 3117.
S. B. - I. 477.
29 - 1 - 32.）

Headquarters, Crime Branch,
January 27, 1932.

Name .......... Edward Marvin, alias Ma
                Wing, alias Ng Yick Wing

Born .......... March 21, 1901, Sunning
                District, Kwangtung

Occupation .... Formerly a clerk in the
                American Consulate at
                Hongkong

Height ........ About 5'7" or 5'8"

Build ......... Very slender

The original of the above photograph was arrested
in Hongkong some months ago whilst carrying on a regular
business in fraudulent travel documents. He was
released on $1,000.00 bail, but absconded. He was
in the United States from 1916 to 1925, and speaks
English with a strong American accent.

If located, please notify Headquarters, Crime
Branch, immediately.

R. J. Aiers
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

姓名 .......... 爱德华·马文（Edward Marvin），化名马荣（Ma Wing），又名吴翼荣（Ng Yick Wing）

出生 .......... 1901 年 3 月 21 日，广东新宁地区

职业 .......... 前香港美国领事馆职员

身高 .......... 约 5 英尺 7 英寸或 5 英尺 8 英寸

体型 .......... 非常瘦削

上述照片的原件系数月前在香港被捕，当时其正从事伪造旅行证件的常规生意。他以 1,000.00 美元保释获释，但随后潜逃。他于 1916 年至 1925 年间在美国居住，讲英语带有浓重的美国口音。

如发现其行踪，请立即通知刑事处总部。

OFFICE OF
THE TREASURY ATTACHÉ

UNITED STATES TREASURY DEPARTMENT
AMERICAN CONSULATE GENERAL
SHANGHAI, CHINA

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. C. REGISTRY S. D. D. 3117 19. 1. 32.）

January 19th, 1932.

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police, C. I. E.,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Mr. Aiers,

There is enclosed herewith copy of a photograph of Edward Marwin, alias Ma Wing, alias Ng Yick Wing ( ) a former clerk in the American Consulate at Hong Kong, discharged in 1928, when he was suspected of forging Chinese travel documents.

Some months ago Marwin was arrested in Hong Kong in the course of a raid on the Yick Tai firm where numerous papers seized indicated that a regular business in fraudulent travel documents was being carried on.

Marwin and the manager of the Yick Tai firm, Chan Woon Chung, were released on $1500.00 bail each as the police desired to await the receipt of forged Siamese passports discovered in Seattle, bearing forged American visas, before formally charging them.

When the Hong Kong police attempted to find them to prefer charges against them, they were found not to be in Hong Kong and the police suspect Marwin is in Shanghai or Nanking, where he is supposed to have friends. Chan Woon Chung is thought to have gone to Canton. Bail of Marwin and Chan has been estreated and they are now fugitives subject to arrest on being found in Hong Kong.

The photograph of Marwin was taken in 1925 and is a good likeness. The following is a description of Marwin:-

Born March 21, 1901, Sunning District, Kwangtung.

About 5' 7" or 5' 8" tall

Very slender - weight about 130 pounds

Speaks Cantonese with Sz Yap accent

Speaks English fluently and idiomatically but with lower East Side New York accent.

Was in the United States from 1916 to 1925, being admitted

警务处副总监，C. I. E.，
中国上海。

亲爱的艾尔斯先生：

随函附上爱德华·马温（Edward Marwin）的照片副本一份，此人化名马荣（Ma Wing），又名吴翼荣（Ng Yick Wing）（ ），系前香港美国领事馆职员，于 1928 年被解职，当时他涉嫌伪造中国旅行证件。

数月前，马温在香港因警方突袭益泰公司（Yick Tai firm）而被捕，现场查获的大量文件表明，该公司正在从事伪造旅行证件的常规生意。

马温与益泰公司经理陈润忠（Chan Woon Chung）各以 1,500.00 美元保释获释，因为警方希望等待在西雅图发现的、贴有伪造美国签证的伪造暹罗护照送达后，再对他们正式提出指控。

当香港警方试图寻找他们以提出指控时，发现他们已不在香港，警方怀疑马温在上海或南京，据说他在那里有朋友。据信陈润忠已前往广州。马温和陈的保释金已被没收，他们现在是逃犯，一旦在香港被发现即可逮捕。

马温的照片摄于 1925 年，相貌十分相似。以下是马温的描述：-

出生于 1901 年 3 月 21 日，广东新宁地区。

身高约 5 英尺 7 英寸或 5 英尺 8 英寸

非常瘦削 - 体重约 130 磅

讲粤语，带四邑口音

英语流利且地道，但带有纽约下东区口音。

1916 年至 1925 年期间在美国，通过其父亲（英国籍，华裔）在海外出生而获得公民身份
